objective.jobToBeDone: Maintain the client directory by browsing, searching, creating, updating, and removing client records used across projects.
objective.primaryDecision: Which client to act on — select a client from the directory to edit, delete, or use on a project.
objective.usageFrequency: Occasional / back-office — opened when setting up or editing a project or when client master data needs updating.

criticalActions.presentation: primary-surface — filterable paginated table as the dominant surface
primary-button in toolbar — opens inline panel or modal form
inline-row-command — edit action on selected row, pre-populates detail panel
inline-row-command — destructive row action with confirmation, never a form

informationHierarchy: 1. Searchable/filterable client list (name, company, email) — the dominant surface
2. Filter controls folded into the list toolbar (name, company, email)
3. Create client action in the toolbar
4. Per-row edit and delete actions on the selected client
5. Edit detail panel (pre-populated from selected row) for update
objective.successCriteria: A project manager can find any client in under 5 seconds, create a new client in one step, and edit or delete a client without leaving the directory view.
antiPatterns: Separate full-width form sections for update and delete below the list
clientId exposed as a manually typed input field
One section per operation (create / update / delete each in their own section)
Audit timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt) shown as editable fields
